code: Title screen: tap X 39-54 times in 360 frames
note: Keep each gap under 16 frames; 7-9 frames per tap works, 6 or 10 does not. Sets $7E542D=12 ($C1:6EC3) with a sound. PAL 7.2 s, JP 6 s.

code: Title screen: tap X 40-47 times in 360 frames
note: The beta checks (count & $F8) = $28, a narrower window: every 9 frames works, every 7 does not.

devices.Game Genie: DAFE-84A7 DA16-8DDC (eu) / DAFF-EDD7 DA16-8DDC (jp) / DAFF-EDD7 DA15-84DC (beta)

effect: Battle stages 11 (SUPERSTAR) and 12 (HAPPY HAPPY) on the stage select
note: Stage count; the title X trick sets the same value. Checked on EU: Left from stage 1 goes to 12. Game Genie: the two LDA #$0A before STA $7E542D (boot $C0:1EFA, JP/beta $C0:1F0F; password $C2:6A7F, beta $C2:6A77) load 12; Mesen: $542D = 12 in all three, Left from stage 1 goes to 12 on EU.

effect: Full equipment at every stage start (8 bombs, 8 fire, speed 2, abilities 7)
note: The flag the area passwords set. EU: $144F=8, $48B9=8, $126F=2, $48D1=7 at 1-1. Game Genie: $C4:03AB BEQ +$19 -> BEQ +0, so the full-equipment block always runs; Mesen with 5358: $144F=8, $48B9=8, $126F=2, $48D1=7 (EU, JP, beta; 2/1/0/0 without).

effect: Hard mode: every enemy takes one more hit
note: The flag 6514 sets. Flag checked under the cheat; the effect was checked with 6514. Game Genie: $C3:00B6 BEQ +3 -> BEQ +0, so every enemy gets the extra hit point; Mesen, JP and beta: enemy HP 2 instead of 1 (the same as 7E2902:01 run on JP).
Already known.

effect: Stage 12's three cut battle variants: the balloon arena with the arrow panels in other places
note: The battle switch at $C6:62EF gives every stage four data sets (base + $542E) except stage 11 ($75) and stage 12, fixed at $6D, so stage 12 always plays the same way. Sets $6E-$70 follow it and no case names them. With the set byte (EU file $6636C, JP $66358, beta $66362) changed to each, stage 12 loads and plays with its own arrow-panel layout, the same in all three versions. Mesen. Image: $6D as shipped, then $6E, $6F, $70.

effect: A rising sweep the game never plays
note: Effects go through $C0:07A1 (table $80:80DC); no code, script or actor asks for 06 (sound command $0D, data at APU $2C84). It is a 2-channel rising sweep of about 0.76 s. 25 is an empty placeholder (an instrument and volume, then no notes) and 2B replays the last voice clip, so neither is a sound of its own. Recorded in BizHawk at the logo.

effect: Two title-set sounds the game never plays
note: The effect table $80:80DC maps 62-6B onto commands 32-3B again, so 68 and 6A share commands 38 and 3A with 5C and 5E. Those two are sent only by the final boss's actors (types $4D and $4E, spawned only in stage $46), when the boss stage's own sound set 37 is loaded; in BizHawk the final boss sent 5C twelve times with set 37 loaded. Nothing asks for 68 or 6A, so the title/menu set 38's own versions of commands 38 and 3A never play: 68 a mid tone with a sharp attack of about 1.1 s, 6A a quiet tone rising to about 1 kHz, about 1.2 s. Recorded in BizHawk at the title with set 38 loaded.

effect: A spoken clip no character ever says
note: Voices are requested with type 03 through $C0:07A1. Voices 0B-13 come only from the battle results request at $C6:0F7F, which sends $0B + the winner's character ($1347, written at $C4:04BE as the select screen's choice - 1, 0-7), so it can send 0B-12 but never 13; in BizHawk the results screen sent 0B, 0D and 11 for characters 1, 3 and 7. Voice 13 (sample set 2F at $D5:E5E9, command 79) is the only voice that uses set 2F, and nothing loads that set. About 1.2 s. Recorded in BizHawk.
